entities.summary:
21 is the twenty-first century, the era following the twentieth and preceding the twenty-second. This era began on January 1, 2001, and will conclude on December 31, 2100.

21, like its predecessors, is a time of global interconnectedness, technological advancements, and shifting geopolitical landscapes. It is characterized by the rise of the internet, social media, and digital technologies that have transformed the way we live, work, and interact with one another.

The early 21st century saw the emergence of new global challenges, including climate change, pandemics, and economic inequality. The period also witnessed significant advancements in fields such as medicine, energy, and space exploration.

As the 21st century unfolds, it will be marked by the increasing pace of technological progress, the growing importance of sustainable development, and the evolving nature of global politics and international relations.

The twenty-first century will be remembered as a time of both great promise and profound challenge, as humanity navigates the complexities of the modern world and works towards a more equitable and sustainable future.

In the words of futurist and inventor, Ray Kurzweil, 'The twenty-first century will be a time of great transformation, as we move from a world of information to a world of abundance.'
